Kasraoui–Zeng already gives all finite mixed moments through a generating function; the originality assessment rests on the explicit joint Gaussian limit and orthogonal-mechanism proof, not counting symmetry, individual marginals, or finite covariance alone. Significant residual priority risk is disclosed.
residual_risks: The 2006 complete joint generating function makes all finite mixed moments implicit, so the covariance component alone is covered; historical priority of the joint CLT requires independent inspection of other possible asymptotic generating-function analyses.

value.rationale: Crossings and nestings form the natural competing pair of local configurations in a chord diagram. Strict negative finite covariance versus independent Gaussian global fluctuations is a nontrivial structural dependence phenomenon. The exact finite correlation and orthogonal-projection mechanism explain why the local competition disappears at the n^(3/2) scale; this is more than a known marginal CLT or enumeration rephrasing.
